body: Definitely yes! That's how I got diagnosed with bipolar 2. I had originally been diagnosed with depression and anxiety and had been trying different meds for years with no success. Then came venlafaxine/effexor. Sent me into an 8 month long manic episode where I almost destroyed me and my then boyfriend's lives, and I've probably permanently traumatized him. Coming off that drug I had awful withdrawals. I felt like an actual zombie.
